title: Find the full names and colleges of members who have incurred an expense ov
question: Find the full names and colleges of members who have incurred an expense over $150 and also paid their dues before any other member who meets the same expense condition.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  m.XCL_035,
  m.XCL_036,
  mj.XCL_033
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e
  ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
JOIN income AS i
  ON m.XCL_034 = i.XCL_029
JOIN major AS mj
  ON m.XCL_042 = mj.XCL_030
WHERE e.XCL_020 > 150
  AND i.XCL_027 = 'Dues'
  AND i.XCL_025 = (
    SELECT MIN(i2.XCL_025)
    FROM member AS m2
    JOIN expense AS e2
      ON m2.XCL_034 = e2.XCL_022
    JOIN income AS i2
      ON m2.XCL_034 = i2.XCL_029
    WHERE e2.XCL_020 > 150
      AND i2.XCL_027 = 'Dues'
  )

  m.XCL_036,

FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_022"

    SELECT MIN(T5."XCL_025")

    INNER JOIN income AS T5 ON T4."XCL_034" = T5."XCL_029" AND T5."XCL_027" = 'Dues'
